title: api_rate_budget row
description: Logical row for table api_rate_budget (see shared/databases/migrations/008_api_rate_budget.sql). One row per upstream API quota, shared by every worker process that calls it. Solves the aggregate-rate problem: each worker's in-process token bucket is correct alone and wrong in sum, so N workers on one API key permit N times the intended rate. Backed by Postgres rather than Redis because every worker already holds a pgxpool and already treats Postgres-down as total outage, so this adds no new partial-failure surface — and because rows here survive restarts, where a Redis fixed-window scheme would hand out a fresh burst on every rolling deploy.

budget_key.description: Names the QUOTA, not the worker: 'finnhub' is one budget shared by every caller using FINNHUB_API_KEY. Callers passing different keys are not sharing anything

tokens.description: Current balance, fractional. Refilled lazily at read time from refill_per_sec × (now() − updated_at) rather than by a background job, so there is nothing to schedule and nothing to drift

refill_per_sec.description: Sustained request rate. 1.0 for Finnhub's free tier (60 requests/minute)

burst.description: Maximum accumulation, i.e. the largest allowed spike. Must be at least 1: a smaller burst could never satisfy a request, so every acquisition would silently degrade to the caller's local limiter

updated_at.description: Advanced on every successful acquisition; the lazy-refill baseline
